description: Does a write through a recordset opened before any level succeed at each of eight BeginTrans levels, and which levels are there after eight Rollbacks? Fixture r-txn-1b-main-accdb (tables T, S, C, Lv, R, Wide, Big, saved QueryDef QInsMid), opened writable through DBEngine.OpenDatabase in Workspaces(0). Open dynaset rw on Lv and snapshot rd on SELECT SUM(V) AS Tot, COUNT(*) AS Cnt FROM Lv, read rd. Eight times, with level n = 1..8: Workspaces(0).BeginTrans, DBEngine.Errors, rw.MoveFirst, rw.Move(n - 1), rw.Edit, V = 2^(n - 1), rw.Update, DBEngine.Errors. Then nine times: Workspaces(0).Rollback, DBEngine.Errors, rd.Requery, read rd. Finally Lv through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
